verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents an official MCP Server that lets users manage their account in natural language through any MCP-capable AI assistant. Documented tasks include sending emails, checking delivery stats, managing domains and troubleshooting DNS. The probe confirms the MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the conversational workflow works as described, a detailed list of which operations the MCP tools cover, and any natural-language interface built into Mailgun itself (it depends on an external AI assistant).
